body: Ticker search now always navigates to /ticker/{q} on click and Enter key. Removed the redundant /search?q=X → 302 → /ticker/X two-step. Added 'change' event listener alongside 'input' for browser compatibility. Form submit handler always calls navigate(). Single e.preventDefault() + window.location.href — no more Go button step.
title: INTAKE UX ticker search auto-navigate — remove redundant Go button step
